_how_to_edit: Hooks are line 1 of every caption; questions are line 3. Add, remove or reword them freely.
Slots in [brackets]: [Country] and [Country2] are country names from the video; [year] is a year;
[x] and [y] are values exactly as the video shows them (e.g. 40.1M, 18.8%); [metric] is the topic name;
anything else (e.g. [surprising move], [fact]) is a few free words that restate a computed fact.
Every number in a caption must come from the facts the code computes, and the words outside the slots
are kept exactly as written here, so keep them true for any video. No em dashes.
'facts' lists which computed facts a hook suits: surprising, surprising_only, biggest_rise, biggest_fall,
crossover, sharpest, peak, record_high, record_low, or any. Leave it out and the hook suits any fact.
'fill' is the plain fill used when Gemini is off or fails, with {country} {country2} {year} {from_year}
{to_year} {from} {to} {value} {metric}; it can be one string or one per fact kind (plus 'default').
A hook with no 'fill' is only used by Gemini.
'openers' are the question the VIDEO opens with (big on screen, then the header) and the answer its
end card reveals. 'fact' picks the computed fact; the answer is filled from it in code (no Gemini).
The first openers whose fact exists in a video are preferred. Keep questions free of numbers.
A hook or question with 'opener' is written for the video that opens with that question: such a video
uses ONLY those (they tease the answer the end card reveals, so they never name it), and no other video
uses them. config.yaml opening.hook_template picks the opener every new video starts with.
'which_last' is every guess-the-loser question (config.yaml opening.phrasings, worded per video): in its
hooks {question} is the exact question the video shows, so the caption's line 1 always matches the screen.
A which_last caption's line 1 is that question + 'Guess before the end' or 'Don't scroll before the end'
(the two which_last hooks); consecutive reels alternate between them (captions.generate_for_run).

hooks.text: Nobody talks about what happened to [Country] in [year]

hooks.fill: Look at {country} in {year} and tell me that's normal
